title: Research: exact scratch capacity and a complete linear tape bill for PR #2915's ordered high-field ADD
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

[PR #2982](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2982) leaves the ordered high-field ADD inside its single-cube tariff unpriced. This package proves a local reserve and physical-I/O bound for the unchanged retained PR #2915 `kernels.added` and its actual pooled `stream.add_pass`.

For odd Q>=3, canonical positive extents B,M,S and c in {-4,-2,-1,1,2,4}, let V=BQMQS and b=bit_length(Q)+1. Exactly **10+[S>1] additional scratch roles** suffice and are attained in every call, sharpening PR #2809's conservative 32-role lexical allowance for a complete ADD. **Six additional numerical words** suffice, with an attaining fixture; outside the coefficient callback this is PR #2810's bound for the same `stream.add_pass`, composed here with the actual callback (at most five). The complete local physical read/write/unit-move bill, including encoded arithmetic and pool acquisitions, is **at most 4096V**, or **4102V** including returned-output disposal. Borrowed payload, counts, numerical residents and occupied entry roles are preserved; the output is separately owned.

The exact non-arithmetic invoice extends the existing countdown and payload bills to the pooled call. PR #2877's all-width countdown identity (its zero case was also derived earlier in PR #2473), plus one acquisition read, gives the fully drained pooled l-digit Counter cost `15n+14l-5 popcount(n)+37+4[n=0]`; PR #2473's exact payload bill 23V+29 gains three payload acquisitions; the one-bit-suffix path and the three marginal lifecycles are priced from source. Source-derived numerical bounds complete the bill; no finite timing ratio is extrapolated. An occupied-content corollary is stated separately from backing capacity, which PR #2905 and PR #2923 bound for the Counter and joint numerical/count backing of the same ADD.

Artifact: `research/high-add-scratch-invoice/README.md`, with `PROOF.md`, source pins, a typed receipt, verifier and controls. Status: **scoped source-level proof and independent audit**, with finite corroboration. No new construction, kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change. Full finite-control machine steps, marker/template provisioning, enclosing setup, reversed-field B1 swaps, physical backing and whole-stage stock remain separate.

## Task and overlap

Scope is **changed** from a whole-stage envelope to this named actual-source reserve/time implication. Covered conditional 8194/6748 coefficients, lcm-wrapper fits, cutoff comparisons and PR #3113's m=73 source gap are not repeated. The distinct [active NODE/MERGE claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19001777) audits enclosing coordinate and ownership refinement; this package audits only ordered ADD. The family decision is **narrow**: no dependent construction search.

The concrete method is a chronological lifetime and literal-loop proof with an independent integer invoice, modular-address oracle and physical metering on complete bounded packets. The acceptance/stop rule was to include every constructor, numerical and disposal charge or report the missing term. The finite domain has Q in {3,5,9,17}, four spectator choices, six coefficients, four occupied-pool cases and nine complete basis columns at Q=3; isolated arithmetic checks reach 82-bit words. The session cap was 60 minutes. The declared local milestone is complete; full caller restoration/capacity and H2 composition remain obligations.

This contribution adds the exact pooled scratch inventory, the pooled and marginal invoice terms and an explicit complete local I/O constant including arithmetic. PR #3041's residual/CALL and the enclosing-node work remain distinct.

## Validation

CPython 3.12, standard library; all commands run locally and sequentially:

```sh
python3 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/high-add-scratch-invoice
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/high-add-scratch-invoice
```

Expected primary output:

```text
PASS_HIGH_ADD_SCRATCH_INVOICE cases=109 payload_bits=37241 scratch=10,11 numerical_extra<=6 io<=4096V
```

Registered metadata/source checks, the primary verifier and all ten optimized behavioral groups pass. Evidence: 109 complete packets / 37,241 payload bits; 51 padded/zero countdown cases; 36 isolated numerical checks through 82-bit words. The saved case digest is `9f0fe7257cc2f18a7040e42c2cbf713535a389e8f0cfeaabbaaa38e3f4ffe79a`.

Controls include one fewer scratch role, one fewer numerical slot, extra dirty entry roles, pool reuse, wrong coefficient, an endpoint-preserving extra read, noncanonical count padding, omitted zero charges, three source-pin corruptions and Boolean/integer receipt substitution. Raw physical method interception agrees with summed unique-tape meters; alias meters are not counted twice. Publication preflight matches **34 files**. A committed export of precisely those files passes transport-integrity checking and the direct verifier/control suite from a read-only directory without Git metadata. `git diff --cached --check` passed before committing.

The proof, rather than finite tests, supplies the all-width claim. Not run or claimed: full selected GL64 payload, selected supplier cold replay, whole caller/bootstrap verification, formal proof, hosted CI, independent human review or general interrupted-call recovery. Failure fixtures are explicitly cleaned by the harness. One initial invocation of the inherited publication helper with `-I` failed its local-module import; the documented command above passes without modifying that helper.

## Open next questions

See the structured questions in `research/high-add-scratch-invoice/TASK.json` and the README.

1. Audit `high_route.extents/execute`'s remaining encoded setup, then compose sign/scaling/translation and complete native B1 charges, retaining owned intermediates and both swaps on reversed ADDs. This would advance PR #2982's single-cube tariff; native contracts and those separate ledgers remain blockers.
2. Join local role/content bounds to actual physical backing and caller stock at the same chronological cuts, retaining entry residents, markers/templates, blank backing, native inventories and recursive lifetimes. No whole-stage reserve follows from occupied content alone.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The released PR #2982 handoff made a useful bounded task possible after the card's old numerical-envelope territory was covered. A compact list of unclosed local implementation obligations beside the broad stock card would reduce time spent distinguishing coefficient arithmetic from actual implementation work. An index of merged audits by the source routine they bound (for example every `stream.add_pass` audit) would also surface earlier countdown, numerical and backing results sooner.
